name: Frontis-MA1-30B
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 (config.json max_position_embeddings 262144). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507: 48 full GQA layers (kv heads 4, head_dim 128) and 0 other layers, per the base config.json.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-30. A finetune of Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 with execution-grounded SFT and RL (OpenMLE draft/improve/debug/crossover operators). Same 30.5B total / 3.3B active, 128 experts. Recorded because the card prints a controlled same-harness row for the Qwen base and for this model on the official 22-task MLE-Bench Lite. The card itself stresses these are model-harness SYSTEM scores, not standalone one-shot generation. Licence apache-2.0.

benchmarks.name: MLE-Bench Lite Medal Average (OpenMLE-Evo fixed)
benchmarks.config: Card 'Controlled 30B comparison' table, Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 34.85% vs Frontis-MA1-30B 53.03%, same OpenMLE-Evo harness. Official 22-task split, 3 runs, 12h sandbox per task. Card stresses this is a model-harness system score, not standalone one-shot generation.

benchmarks.name: MLE-Bench Lite Valid Rate /22
benchmarks.config: Same table, base 17.33/22 vs 21.67/22 -> 78.8 vs 98.5 on a 0-100 scale of the 22-task split. The OpenMLE-Evo-Max row (22.00/22, 66.67%, 0.8053) is excluded: it changes the search system as well as the model.
